Hi Samir — 10:30am PST works; I've scheduled the 30-min demo for Wed, Feb 12, 10:30–11:00am PST and sent a calendar invite with the Zoom link. Aditya (cc'd) will join to cover performance and pricing details.

Quick answers while you have them:
- Latency: typical 1k-token generative request on our hosted-config (gpt-style open architecture) is ~350–650ms per token tail latency depending on model and prompt shape; 95th-pct can be higher for longer seqs. We'll bring concrete perf numbers for the model variants you might try.
- Pricing: evaluation accounts have a credit-backed sandbox; per-token pricing ranges by model (e.g., smaller open models ~ $0.0006/token, larger instruction-tuned variants ~ $0.003/token). We'll go over exact tiers and options in the call.

Attachment: HostedAPI-demo-deck.pdf

Agenda updated: include brief perf slide and example billing scenarios.

See you Wed at 10:30am PST.

Best,
Marissa
